| **On GitHub** | [`LEADERBOARD.md`](LEADERBOARD.md) |

**Both boards are generated by CI ([`.github/workflows/leaderboard.yml`](../../../.github/workflows/leaderboard.yml)) -- don't edit either by hand.**

## The protocol

Train on [HAP1, K562 and MDA-MB-231](../../../data/holdout_thp1/train_thp1_holdout.jsonl.gz);
predict [THP1](../../../data/holdout_thp1/holdout_thp1_features.jsonl.gz). 5,496 rows,
202 positives (3.7%), ranked by AUPRC.

The question is whether a model generalizes to a cell line it has never seen a single
row of -- harder than generalizing to an unseen lncRNA, and the reason scores here sit
well below what a within-cell-line split would give.

Scoring reads THP1's rows from `data/processed/lncrna_rra_day14.jsonl.gz`, per
`test_path` in [`challenge.yaml`](challenge.yaml). There is no separate answers file.

This is an **honour-system board, not a blind benchmark** -- the labels are published
data. [`docs/PARTICIPATE.md`](../../../docs/PARTICIPATE.md#the-rules) explains why it
cannot be made blind and what "don't look" means concretely. That document is the
single source of truth for the format, the rules and how to read the scores; this file
deliberately does not repeat it.

## Submitting, in short

Full instructions in [`docs/PARTICIPATE.md`](../../../docs/PARTICIPATE.md). The
30-second version:

```bash
# 1. build a valid entry with no setup at all
python3 ../../../scripts/make_barebones_submission.py --submitter YOUR-HANDLE \
    --out submissions/YOUR-HANDLE-barebones

# 2. check it locally -- same numbers CI will publish
python3 ../../../scripts/score_submission.py submissions/YOUR-HANDLE-barebones
```

Then open a PR from a `submission/`-prefixed branch **on this repo, not a fork**.
CI rescores every entry from `predictions.csv`, and commits the regenerated board
onto your branch.

## Regenerating the split

```bash
python scripts/split_holdout_cellline.py --holdout THP1 --out data/holdout_thp1
```

[`scripts/split_holdout_cellline.py`](../../../scripts/split_holdout_cellline.py) also
writes `holdout_thp1_labels.jsonl.gz` -- the answer key. It is gitignored
(`data/holdout_*/holdout_*_labels.jsonl.gz`) so a stray `git add data/` can't publish
it, and scoring doesn't need it. It exists for the case where a future challenge holds
out genuinely unpublished data and the labels really do need to live somewhere private.
